text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): when refs/remotes/origin/main does not exist, `now <original-text>` returns the raw PROPOSE_PROTECTED_BASE_UNAVAILABLE error, while `propose <change> --intent <file>` converts the same failure into a Fail-Grant challenge. The intent-level facade should reach the same handler so the next step is a decision, not a dead end.
